name: E-wing: Type B
description: The E-Wing: Type B was a modified version of the base E-wing escort starfighter manufactured by FreiTek Incorporated. Due to the initial designs of the E-wing relying on synthetically spin-sealed Tibanna gas to power the laser cannons, the starfighters' weapon system were found to be underpowered. The gas broke down too quickly, reducing the effective range of the E-wing's weapons.
